correctness.rationale: The exact RESULT.md fixes the period-three critical orbit F_s(0)=1, F_s(1)=-s, F_s(-s)=0, with A_s=1-1/[s²(s+1)] and B_s=s+1/[s²(s+1)], s∈(1.09,1.10). On J=[-1/2,-3/10], G_s=F_s² is a uniformly decreasing diffeomorphism with derivative below -2, and G_s(J) contains [-1/2,0]. Hence its inverse h_s is a contraction, h_s^n(0) converges uniformly to the repelling 2-cycle point p_s. Independent exact rational evaluation at s=109/100 and 11/10 confirms v_s∈J and sign reversals R_s=G_s(v_s)-v_s>1/20 and <-1/10 respectively; the three-cycle equations hold exactly. Thus for all sufficiently large n the critical value crosses h_s^n(0), producing a superattracting capture. Compactness and disjointness of the repelling 2-cycle and the attracting 3-cycle force unbounded least entry times. The published common zeta and Fibonacci repeller are appropriately attributed to Olivares-Vinales Proposition 7.1; the proof itself establishes infinitely many marked combinatorial types, not an exhaustive parameter census.
